Korean artist Hwang J.H  creates Fetal Movement (태동), a kinetic sculpture that transforms industrial machinery into an unsettling representation of early human life. Measuring 40 × 40 × 90 cm, the work features a mechanical figure lying on its back, constructed from exposed metal components, articulated limbs, and a skeletal framework. Driven by servo motors, its movements evoke the fragile, involuntary gestures of a developing fetus. #art #artist #weird #scary #niche

I 3d printed a mechanical garden that grows when people subscribe to my channel. It's sort of like kinetic art, and I can program all 24 flowers to perform a bunch of cool animations and sequences. For example, I can make them bloom as the sun rises in the morning, or as the day progresses. They're a bit loud all running together, so I wouldn't keep it doing something like the wave all day, but when I let them go wild, it's pretty freaking awesome to watch.
